# Domain

> > Australia's leading property portal connecting buyers, sellers, renters, and investors with real estate agents, market data, and expert guidance.

Domain is Australia's comprehensive real estate marketplace offering property search, valuation tools, market research, and professional advice across all major cities including Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, and Canberra. The platform serves first-time buyers, experienced investors, renters, and homeowners with data-driven insights and agent connections.

## Key Topics

- Property Valuation
- Real Estate Agents
- First-Home Buyers
- Property Investment
- Market Insights
- House Prices

- Sydney
- Melbourne
- Brisbane

- Agent Search
- Domain App

## Core Property Tools

- [Search for real estate agents to sell your property in Australia](https://www.domain.com.au/real-estate-agents): Search and find real estate agents across Australia by location
- [Property Value Estimates & History | Domain](https://www.domain.com.au/property-profile): Get property valuations, rental estimates, and market trends
- [Sell | Property profiles, Price Estimates, Nearby Activity, Agent comparisons and Fee Quotes](https://www.domain.com.au/sell): Tools and information to help sell your property in Australia
- [Domain for Owners | Personalised Home Owner Experience](https://www.domain.com.au/owners): Personalized homeowner tools for property valuation and insights

## Market Research & Data

- [Research](https://www.domain.com.au/research): Property market research reports and data-driven insights
- [Real Estate Auction Results: 15th Mar to 21st Mar 2026](https://www.domain.com.au/auction-results): Weekly auction results and clearance rates across Australian cities
- [Real Estate and Property Market News](https://www.domain.com.au/news): Latest real estate and property market news in Australia

## Buying, Selling & Investment Guides

- [Buying & Selling Property: Real Estate Tips, Guides & Advice](https://www.domain.com.au/advice): Real estate guides and professional advice on buying and selling
- [Buying Property: Tips, Guides & Advice](https://www.domain.com.au/advice/buying): Property buying guides and tips for first-time and experienced buyers
- [Property Investment Strategies, Tips & Advice](https://www.domain.com.au/advice/investing): Investment strategies and advice for property investors
- [Renting A Home: Renting Tips, Guides & Advice](https://www.domain.com.au/advice/renting): Renting guides covering tenant rights and rental agreements

## Lifestyle & Inspiration

- [Domain Living: Home Trends & Inspiration](https://www.domain.com.au/living): Home trends, interior design inspiration, and lifestyle content
